reviews.title: the app is good and all but there are problems i genuinely don’t understand
reviews.text: I really like this app because I made a few new friends but there’s something about this app that I genuinely don’t understand. There could be fully grown adults on here texting me about severely inappropriate things and when I decline and report them (since i’m a minor) their account only gets a warning while my account on the other hand gets it’s chat taken away (my chatting privileges get abnormal) or I get banned for doing absolutely nothing (they claim there was suspicious activity even though like I said before that im a minor and I don’t enjoy interacting with weirdos like that) . I’m tired of this happening to me and it’s causing me to lose friends because of something I haven’t done.
